006package dev.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Map;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.impl.DefaultContainerModelAssemblySupport;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * Common interface for model container support classes.
016 *
017 * @param <MI>
018 *          the model instance Java type
019 * @param <NMI>
020 *          the named model instance Java type
021 * @param <FI>
022 *          the field instance Java type
023 * @param <AI>
024 *          the assembly instance Java type
025 * @param <CI>
026 *          the choice instance Java type
027 * @param <CGI>
028 *          the choice group instance Java type
029 */
030public interface IContainerModelAssemblySupport<
031    MI extends IModelInstance,
032    NMI extends INamedModelInstance,
033    FI extends IFieldInstance,
034    AI extends IAssemblyInstance,
035    CI extends IChoiceInstance,
036    CGI extends IChoiceGroupInstance> extends IContainerModelSupport<MI, NMI, FI, AI> {
037
038  /**
039   * Get an empty, immutable container.
040   *
041   * @param <MI>
042   *          the model instance Java type
043   * @param <NMI>
044   *          the named model instance Java type
045   * @param <FI>
046   *          the field instance Java type
047   * @param <AI>
048   *          the assembly instance Java type
049   * @param <CI>
050   *          the choice instance Java type
051   * @param <CGI>
052   *          the choice group instance Java type
053   * @return the empty container
054   */
055  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
056  @NonNull
057  static <
058      MI extends IModelInstance,
059      NMI extends INamedModelInstance,
060      FI extends IFieldInstance,
061      AI extends IAssemblyInstance,
062      CI extends IChoiceInstance,
063      CGI extends IChoiceGroupInstance> IContainerModelAssemblySupport<MI, NMI, FI, AI, CI, CGI> empty() {
064    return DefaultContainerModelAssemblySupport.EMPTY;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Get a listing of all choice instances.
069   *
070   * @return the listing
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  List<CI> getChoiceInstances();
074
075  /**
076   * Get a listing of all choice group instances.
077   *
078   * @return the listing
079   */
080  @NonNull
081  Map<String, CGI> getChoiceGroupInstanceMap();
082}
